correctness.rationale: In characteristic three \(F_x=yq\) and \(F_y=xq\); simple g roots exclude singularities off q=0. At either simple q root, the restriction is a triple line w³ and exact division F=w³+sH reduces singular support to three simple roots of \(P_r=H(0,x,0)\). \(P_r'\ne 0\) makes (s,H,w) regular formal coordinates, proving local equation \(s\xi+w^3\) and Jacobian quotient \(k[[w]]/(w^3)\), length 3 at each of six points. The example q=uv, g=u⁴+u³v+2uv³+v⁴ meets the conditions and is independently enumerated over F27. Normality follows from isolated singularities and the S2 hypersurface condition.

value.rationale: Provides a uniform, nonempty open bad-characteristic classification for the natural Rams–Schütt quartic Z family rather than an arbitrary isolated quartic. The six wild rational double points lie on two triple-line fibres and their Jacobian singular scheme has nonreduced length 18; the K3 minimal resolution consequently contains six \(A_2\) chains. This infinitesimal structure is not recoverable from point counts and informs geometry of the excluded characteristic.
